report.answer_text:
In 2025, the two countries reported 52 wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) cases combined, according to the WHO's Polio IHR Emergency Committee statement. Afghanistan reported 21 of them and Pakistan reported 31.[1]
The Afghan total has risen since the first reports. A count from December 2025 had 9 cases in Afghanistan and 30 in Pakistan[2]. The WHO later said that, of 14 newly reported Afghan cases, 11 had paralysis onset in 2025[3]. That is why the 2025 figure was revised upward.
For comparison, in 2024 Afghanistan recorded 25 cases and Pakistan 74[4].
